question: Which reasoning operations recur across human solutions, informal model solutions, and formal proof states?
headline: Nine operations are attested in all three source kinds -- human solutions, model-generated solutions, and formal proof states: APPLY_THEOREM, CASE_SPLIT, INTRODUCE (declare/binder/witness), SUBSTITUTE/REWRITE, INDUCT, CONTRADICTION, DISCHARGE, APPLY_DEFINITION and TRANSFORM. Only two of the nine survive an adversarial alignment check with high confidence (INDUCT, CASE_SPLIT); three more are medium (APPLY_THEOREM, CONTRADICTION, INTRODUCE); and four are same-name-different-operation (DISCHARGE, TRANSFORM, APPLY_DEFINITION, SUBSTITUTE/REWRITE). Five informal operations (VERIFY, COUNT, BOUND, EVALUATE, SELECT) have no canonical formal counterpart at all, and two formal categories (AUTOMATION 20.5%, GOAL_MANAGEMENT 0.4%) have no informal counterpart. The recurrence result is REAL BUT WEAK: it rests on 769 annotated human steps, and on a lexical proxy whose measured precision on those same 769 steps ranges from 0.08 to 1.00.
limits_read_first: 1. SAMPLE SIZE. The only corpus with per-step operation labels, warrants, preconditions, obligations and typed dependencies is 769 Gold-125/Gold-25 transitions plus 23 hand-authored Gold-10 actions = 792 steps. Everything else in this study is either unlabelled text or single-operation formal traces.

2. 17.7% OF THE ANNOTATED CORPUS HAS NO OPERATION. 136/769 gold steps are core_operation=UNRESOLVED, 125 of them from observed_operation=OTHER. The richest corpus in the estate declines to name the operation for one step in six.
3. ONE OPERATION DOMINATES. TRANSFORM is 305/769 (39.7%) of the gold corpus and 3,074/3,978 (77.3%) of the synthetic corpus. Recurrence of a sink category is close to uninformative.

4. SINGLE DOMAIN, AND CONTAMINATED. Every richly-annotated step is Hendrycks MATH competition mathematics, and MATH is in the training data of every model this project evaluates. No held-out claim can be made from it.

5. GOLD-10 SHOWS NO RECURRENCE AT ALL. 23 hand-authored actions carry 22 distinct operation names. It is a near-bijection between steps and operation names, so it provides zero evidence that operations recur; it is a specification exercise, not a sample.

6. THE FORMAL CORPORA HAVE ONE OPERATION LABEL. action.operation == 'LEAN_TACTIC' on all 56,000 hml_50k_final records and all vnext_10k records, with all five effect maps empty. Tactic text is recoverable, operation semantics are not.

7. NO NEGATIVE EXAMPLES IN ANY FORMAL CORPUS. A Lean trace holds only the steps that were kept. PRM800K's 262,146 -1-rated steps are the only large source of failed reasoning on disk, and they are unverified and MATH-contaminated.

8. THE 1,150-TRANSITION HML_V3 CORPUS IS DELIBERATELY UNREPRESENTATIVE. The goal-management block is over-sampled 27x versus LeanDojo (11.72% vs 0.44%); individual combinators run 38-49x (exacts 7.7% vs 0.18%, all_goals 4.4% vs 0.09%, swap 3.4% vs 0.09%). Its tactic mix must never be quoted as a fact about mathematics.

9. THE MODEL ARM IS A LEXICAL PROXY, NOT AN OPERATION COUNT. Nothing on disk labels operations on model-generated steps. The detector used here was calibrated on the 769 gold spans and its precision ranges from 0.077 (EVALUATE) to 1.000 (INDUCT); 334/769 = 43.4% of gold spans fire no cue at all. Treat every column-B and column-C number as an upper-bounded surface statistic.

10. ANNOTATION IS NOT VERIFICATION. Every operation label in this study was asserted by a human or by a deterministic extractor over human text. To promote any of it, each labelled step would need (a) an independent second annotator with a measured inter-annotator agreement, and (b) for the mathematical content, a machine check -- a SymPy equivalence, or a Lean replay of the corresponding formal step. Neither exists today for any of the 769.

11. THE TWO FORMAL SOURCES ARE NOT INDEPENDENT. lean_canonical_records (241,265) is BUILT FROM LeanDojo Benchmark 4 v10 (source_family=LEANDOJO_BENCHMARK_4_V10). The 8-class replication reported here therefore validates the labelling function, not the generality of the vocabulary.

method.mode: Read-only measurement over local artifacts. No model call, no network, no Lean, no GPU. Every count below was produced by a script in research/operations/ and can be re-run.

sampling.lean_canonical_241k: EXACT -- all 241,265 lines, scanned by line-local regex, validated against full json.loads on the first 2,000 lines (0 mismatches).
sampling.leandojo: random/val.json + random/test.json = 4,000 theorems, 8,766 traced tactics. These are LeanDojo's own uniformly random theorem-level splits from the same pool as train, so this is a random sample, not a prefix.
sampling.math_reference_solutions: EXACT -- all 12,500 problems of prm800k/math_splits, sentence-segmented into 42,963 steps.
sampling.prm800k_model_steps: SUBSAMPLE -- phase1_train + phase1_test + phase2_test = 3,817 records, 1,359 distinct problems, 81,908 rated model steps, 2,598 human-written steps. phase2_train (456 MB, 97,782 records) was NOT scanned, to keep load low during a concurrent live experiment. The sample is therefore ~11% of the corpus and is split-biased toward phase 1 / test.
sampling.hmlv3_1150: Row count and null-field claims re-verified here (918+232=1,150, tactic_family null in all, recorded_effect_class null in all). The tactic-head counts are the PRIOR AGENT's measurement, recovered from source spans against a built mathlib tree; NOT re-derived here.

method.effect_class_rule_recovery: The 8-class Lean effect vocabulary is documented nowhere as a rule. It was recovered here by tabulating effect_signature -> effect_class over all 241,265 records: 198 of 199 distinct signature tails map to a single class. The recovered rule reproduces 179/179 decidable tails with 0 mismatches, and the one ambiguous tail (dg-1|T0|A0|R0|B0) is resolved by n_goals_after == 0.

definition.CANONICAL: changes the mathematics; a mathematician would name it as a proof step
definition.CONTROLLER: drives the prover: search, automation, goal management, environment plumbing

canonical_vs_controller.judgement_not_measurement: This split is a stated judgement. Every contested call is listed in contested_calls.

contested_calls.simp: By far the largest single head (13% of LeanDojo). Classified CONTROLLER because the tactic name does not say which lemmas fired; but a large fraction of `simp` calls are doing what a human would call 'simplify' or 'apply a definition'. This one call moves ~13 points of mass between the two layers.
contested_calls.have: Classified CANONICAL (ASSERT_SUBGOAL). It is also the main vehicle for search-driven forward chaining, i.e. controller behaviour with canonical form.
contested_calls.gcongr: Congruence automation. CANONICAL content, CONTROLLER form.
contested_calls.filter_upwards: A Mathlib domain macro that also introduces binders.
contested_calls.haveI letI: Instance introduction: CANONICAL syntax, plumbing purpose.
contested_calls.linarith positivity omega decide: These discharge real mathematical obligations (an inequality, a decidable proposition). Classified CONTROLLER because the proof object is produced by search, not named by the author.
contested_calls.rfl: Classified CANONICAL DISCHARGE, but `rfl` also silently runs definitional unfolding of unbounded depth.

reconciled_operations.definition: Introduce a new named object or abbreviation into the state without asserting anything about it.
disagreements: reasoning_ontology_v1 separates DECLARE (name an object) from CONSTRUCT (build an object with properties); the gold125 registry has only INTRODUCE_VARIABLE and does not make the distinction.
The Lean effect vocabulary cannot separate DECLARE from INTRODUCE_WITNESS or INTRODUCE_BINDER: all three are INTRODUCE.

reconciled_operations.definition: Build a new mathematical object, witness or configuration and put it in the state.
disagreements: minilang splits witness selection (CHOOSE) from existential elimination (CONSIDER_EXISTS); no HML taxonomy does.

reconciled_operations.definition: State a new proposition and open the obligation to prove it (forward chaining).

in_taxonomies.reasoning_ontology_v1: goal_effect=CREATE_SUBGOAL (an EFFECT axis value, not a core_operation)
in_taxonomies.lean_effect_class: -- absent (goal-creating transitions were EXCLUDED from the 241,265-record corpus)

disagreements: THIS IS THE CLEAREST TAXONOMY DISAGREEMENT IN THE ESTATE. minilang makes HAVE one of its 10 operations; reasoning_ontology_v1 demotes it to an effect on an orthogonal axis; and the Lean corpus deletes the phenomenon entirely (18,315 of 259,580 transitions dropped as goal-creating). `have` is nevertheless the 4th most frequent tactic in LeanDojo.

reconciled_operations.definition: Replace an occurrence by an equal term, or eliminate a variable using an equation.
disagreements: Informal SUBSTITUTE covers what Lean splits into `subst` (variable elimination) and `rw` (directed rewriting). The informal taxonomies have no REWRITE at all, yet `rw` is the single most frequent formal operation (rw alone = 18.91% of LeanDojo).

reconciled_operations.definition: Directed replacement of a subterm using a named equation or iff, left-to-right or right-to-left.

in_taxonomies.lean tactic heads: rw, erw, rwa, simp_rw, nth_rw, rewrite

disagreements: A first-class formal operation with no first-class informal counterpart. This is an annotation-scheme artifact, not a domain difference: human MATH solutions rewrite constantly, but the informal registries fold it into TRANSFORM.

reconciled_operations.definition: Any truth-preserving restatement of the current expression or goal.

in_taxonomies.gold125_registry_v1: TRANSFORM plus ~20 domain-specific children (EXPAND, FACTOR, CROSS_MULTIPLY, CLEAR_DENOMINATOR, ADD_BOTH_SIDES, ...)

disagreements: TRANSFORM is a sink. It absorbs 305/769 (39.7%) of the annotated gold corpus and 3,074/3,978 (77.3%) of the synthetic corpus. Any claim that it 'recurs' is close to vacuous.

reconciled_operations.definition: Discharge or reduce the goal by invoking a named external result.
disagreements: In Lean the premise is always named and machine-checked; in the informal corpora the warrant field may be UNKNOWN. Same name, different epistemic status.

In Lean, definitional unfolding is mostly INVISIBLE: it happens inside `simp`, `rfl` and elaboration. Its measured formal frequency (unfold+delta = 31/8,766 = 0.35%) is therefore a severe undercount, not a real rarity.

reconciled_operations.definition: Replace one goal by an exhaustive family of goals.

in_taxonomies.gold125_gap_registry: MATH-GAP-0001 'Case coverage and branch joins', severity high, recurrence 22

disagreements: The informal registries also need a JOIN (combine the branch results); Lean needs no join, because the goal stack does it. gold125_gap_registry records this as an unrepresentable gap.

reconciled_operations.definition: Argue from the negation of the goal, or derive a falsehood.
disagreements: minilang has no contradiction operation at all; it is folded into RULE.

In the informal corpora DISCHARGE means 'here is the final answer' (90/769, and 89/90 of those contain \boxed{}). In Lean CLOSE means 'this branch of the goal stack is finished' and happens 107,006 times. The two are not the same event.

reconciled_operations.definition: Check a candidate result against a constraint already in the state.
disagreements: VERIFY has NO formal counterpart and cannot have one: in a proof assistant the kernel verifies, so verification never appears as a step. This is a genuine domain difference, not an artifact.

reconciled_operations.definition: Numeric evaluation; cardinality computation; establishing an inequality; listing a finite family; choosing among candidates.
disagreements: These five are first-class in every informal taxonomy and have no first-class formal counterpart: in Lean they are absorbed by automation. The clean statement is that they map to CONTROLLER tactics, not to canonical ones.

reconciled_operations.definition: Reorder, select or replicate work across the goal stack.

in_taxonomies.lean tactic heads: all_goals, any_goals, swap, on_goal, case, focus, next, iterate

disagreements: Present as a MODE in the informal ontology and as concrete TACTICS in Lean, but never as an operation in either. It is 0.44% of LeanDojo and 11.72% of the HML_V3 1,150 corpus, purely because that corpus was sampled for multi-goal states.

reconciled_operations.definition: Invoke a search or normalisation procedure whose internal steps are not recorded.

in_taxonomies.lean tactic heads: simp, simpa, dsimp, ring, linarith, norm_num, omega, aesop, field_simp, ...

disagreements: minilang gives SIMPLIFY operation status; reasoning_ontology_v1 puts it on the knowledge_layer axis instead. This is the second clear taxonomy disagreement.

reconciled_operations.definition: Announce or revise a strategy without changing the mathematical state.

in_taxonomies.lean: -- absent by construction (a trace holds only kept steps)

disagreements: Dominant in model-generated chains (PLAN cue fires on 11.8% of 81,908 PRM800K model steps) and essentially invisible in both the annotated MATH corpus and every formal corpus.

reconciled_operations.definition: Abandon a line of work and resume from an earlier state.

in_taxonomies.lean: -- ABSENT BY CONSTRUCTION. A Lean trace records only steps that were kept.
in_taxonomies.PRM800K: the only large source: 262,146 steps rated -1

disagreements: No formal corpus on disk contains a single backtracking step. This is a hard structural limit on any cross-source claim about failure or revision.

taxonomy_reconciliation_summary.only_computed_one: lean_effect_class_vocabulary (8 classes over 241,265 verified transitions). Every other taxonomy in the estate was asserted, not computed.
three_kinds_of_object_conflated_across_t: OPERATION vocabularies (what the step does): ontology_v1 core_operation 19, gold125 registry 66, gold25 registry 48, minilang 10, master_synthetic 15
EFFECT vocabularies (what changed in the state): lean_effect_class 8, hmlv3_effect_class 8 (stratified, not natural)

NEITHER: reasoning_stages 16 (pipeline phases), micromath relations 8 (representational exposure), representation_genome 42 (design axes, RETIRED), arena_world_dimensions 12 (task difficulty), gold125_gap_registry 13 (expressibility failures)
headline_disagreements: OPERATION COUNT SPREAD IS 8 to 66 with no convergence: 8 (Lean effect), 10 (minilang), 15 (master synthetic), 19 (ontology v1 core), 48 (gold25 registry), 66 (gold125 registry). These are not refinements of one another; they are counts of different things.
ASSERT_SUBGOAL / HAVE: an operation in minilang, an EFFECT axis value in ontology_v1, and DELETED from the 241k Lean corpus. Yet `have` is the 4th most frequent LeanDojo tactic (6.6%).
SIMPLIFY: an operation in minilang; a knowledge_layer value (SYMBOLIC_BACKEND) in ontology_v1; the largest single automation block in Lean (simp+simpa+dsimp = 1,426/8,766 = 16.27% of LeanDojo).
REWRITE: absent from every informal taxonomy (folded into TRANSFORM); the single most frequent formal operation (rw family = 22.34% of LeanDojo).
VERIFY: first-class in ontology_v1 and both gold registries; absent from minilang and structurally impossible in Lean.

The gold25 registry (48 ops) carries typed required_inputs, allowed_types, a warrant_type and an hml_rule per operation; the gold125 registry (66 ops) carries none of that but has frequencies and examples. They are not a v0/v1 pair of the same artifact; the 'older' one is the richer specification.

alignment_confidence.question: For an operation that appears to recur, does the same name mean the same thing across sources?

per_operation.human_MATH: "Let's prove by induction that the $n$th term of the sequence is $2^{n-2}$ ... The base case $n=2$ holds"
per_operation.formal_Lean: `induction n with | zero => .. | succ n ih => ..`
per_operation.why: Same schema (base case + step), same obligations created, same discharge condition. The lexical proxy is exact on the gold set: precision 1.000, recall 1.000, 7/7.

per_operation.human_MATH: "We can split the expression $|5x-1|=x+3$ into two separate cases."
per_operation.formal_Lean: `rcases le_or_lt a b with h | h`
per_operation.why: Both replace one goal with an exhaustive family. CAVEAT: the informal version additionally needs an explicit JOIN step to combine branch results (gold125_gap_registry MATH-GAP-0001, recurrence 22, severity high); Lean needs none, because the goal stack joins implicitly. So the operation matches but its obligations do not.

Same move. But in Lean the premise is named, type-checked and its hypotheses are discharged; in the MATH corpus 'By AM-GM' names no instance and checks no side condition. The reasoning_ontology_v1 warrant axis exists precisely to record this gap, and its UNKNOWN value is used.
Same logical shape. But the informal instances are mostly LOCAL contradictions inside a case analysis, while `by_contra` is a GLOBAL goal transformation. 6 gold instances is too few to separate them.

per_operation.human_MATH: "Let $k$ be a positive integer." / "Call the two integers $x$ and $y$."
per_operation.why: The informal side distinguishes DECLARE (name a thing) from CONSTRUCT (build a witness); Lean distinguishes intro (binder) from obtain (existential elimination) from set/let (abbreviation). The two three-way splits DO NOT LINE UP. The Lean effect vocabulary collapses all of them to INTRODUCE.

The informal event is 'the final answer of the whole problem' and happens ~once per trajectory (90 times in 125 trajectories). The formal event is 'this branch of the goal stack is finished' and happens 44.4% of all steps. Matching them by name would manufacture a 44%-vs-12% 'recurrence' out of two unrelated events.

Informal TRANSFORM is a residual sink (39.7% gold, 77.3% synthetic) covering everything from 'subtract 7 from both sides' to modular reasoning to trig identities. Formal TRANSFORM_TARGET is a precisely defined state delta (the focused goal's target string changed, nothing else did). Equal names, incomparable definitions.

Informally an explicit, citable step (19/769). Formally, definitional unfolding is mostly invisible: it is performed by `simp`, `rfl` and elaboration and never recorded. Measured formal frequency (unfold+delta = 31/8,766 = 0.35%) is an artifact of what Lean logs, not of what proofs do.

Informal SUBSTITUTE (7/769 = 0.9%) means 'put the value you derived into the other equation'. Formal `rw` (18.91% of LeanDojo alone) means 'replace a subterm using a directed equation, anywhere in the goal'. The 21x frequency gap is an annotation-scheme artifact: the informal scheme has no REWRITE, so rewriting is filed as TRANSFORM.

proxy_calibration_headline.reading: Any operation whose only cross-source evidence is the lexical proxy, and whose proxy precision is below ~0.5, should be treated as UNMEASURED rather than as recurring. That is: DECLARE (0.098), EVALUATE (0.077), COUNT (0.169), SELECT (0.087), CONSTRUCT (0.250), CASE_SPLIT (0.220), APPLY_DEFINITION (0.333), SUBSTITUTE (0.333), BOUND (0.380).
